dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef001
dependency_coverage.meaning: For an n-by-n real matrix A, a vector v, and an index i, LocalDef001 A v i is the row-by-vector product sum over all j in Fin n of A(i,j) times v(j).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Its four target occurrences are exactly the components (Ay)_i, (Ax)_i, (Ad)_i, and (AΔx)_i.

dependency_coverage.name: Eq
dependency_coverage.meaning: Eq a b is propositional equality between a and b.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Both hypotheses and the conclusion assert exact equalities of real numbers, not approximate equalities or bounds.

dependency_coverage.name: Fin
dependency_coverage.meaning: Fin n is the finite index type consisting of the n natural-number indices from 0 through n-1.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It indexes every row, column, and vector component, enforcing the common dimension n.

dependency_coverage.name: HAdd.hAdd
dependency_coverage.meaning: HAdd.hAdd applies the addition operation supplied by the relevant heterogeneous-addition instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Here every use is specialized to Real and therefore denotes ordinary real addition with the displayed parenthesization.

dependency_coverage.name: HSub.hSub
dependency_coverage.meaning: HSub.hSub applies the subtraction operation supplied by the relevant heterogeneous-subtraction instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Here every use is specialized to Real and therefore denotes ordinary real subtraction.

dependency_coverage.name: Nat
dependency_coverage.meaning: Nat is the type of natural numbers, including zero.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The universally quantified dimension n may be any natural number, including n = 0.

dependency_coverage.name: Real
dependency_coverage.meaning: Real is the type of real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: All matrix entries, vector components, products, sums, additions, subtractions, and equalities are over the real numbers.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instAdd
dependency_coverage.meaning: Real.instAdd supplies the standard binary addition operation on real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is the underlying operation selected by each real-valued HAdd expression in the hypotheses and conclusion.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instSub
dependency_coverage.meaning: Real.instSub defines real subtraction by a - b = a + (-b).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It gives the ordinary real differences b_i - (Ax)_i, (Ay)_i - b_i, and (Δr_i + (Ad)_i) - rHat_i.

dependency_coverage.name: instHAdd
dependency_coverage.meaning: instHAdd converts an ordinary Add instance into a homogeneous HAdd instance by using that same addition operation.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It routes all Real-valued HAdd calls in the target to standard real addition.

dependency_coverage.name: instHSub
dependency_coverage.meaning: instHSub converts an ordinary Sub instance into a homogeneous HSub instance by using that same subtraction operation.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It routes all Real-valued HSub calls in the target to standard real subtraction.

dependency_coverage.name: Fin.fintype
dependency_coverage.meaning: Fin.fintype n equips Fin n with a finite enumeration containing every valid index.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It permits each matrix-vector product to sum once over all column indices j in Fin n.

dependency_coverage.name: Finset.sum
dependency_coverage.meaning: Finset.sum forms the finite additive sum of a function over the elements of a finite set.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It forms each row sum Σ_j A(i,j)v(j) used by LocalDef001.

dependency_coverage.name: Finset.univ
dependency_coverage.meaning: Finset.univ is the finite set containing every element of a finite type.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: In LocalDef001 it makes the summation range all j in Fin n, with no omitted or restricted indices.

dependency_coverage.name: HMul.hMul
dependency_coverage.meaning: HMul.hMul applies the multiplication operation supplied by the relevant heterogeneous-multiplication instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Each summand in a matrix-vector product is the ordinary real product A(i,j)v(j).

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instAddCommMonoid
dependency_coverage.meaning: Real.instAddCommMonoid supplies the standard additive commutative monoid structure on the real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It provides the associative and commutative real addition and zero used by finite sums; in particular, an empty real sum is zero.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instMul
dependency_coverage.meaning: Real.instMul supplies the standard binary multiplication operation on real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is the underlying multiplication used in every matrix-vector-product summand.

dependency_coverage.name: instHMul
dependency_coverage.meaning: instHMul converts an ordinary Mul instance into a homogeneous HMul instance by using that same multiplication operation.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It routes each Real-valued HMul call in LocalDef001 to standard real multiplication.

binders: n is an arbitrary natural number.
A is an arbitrary real n-by-n matrix, represented as a function Fin n → Fin n → Real.
x, d, Δx, b, rHat, Δr, and y are arbitrary real vectors of length n, represented as functions Fin n → Real.
The hypotheses hres and hupdate are pointwise equations quantified over every index in Fin n.
The conclusion is quantified over every index i in Fin n.
hypotheses: For every i in Fin n, rHat_i = (b_i - (Ax)_i) + Δr_i.
For every i in Fin n, y_i = (x_i + d_i) + Δx_i.
conclusions: For every i in Fin n, (Ay)_i - b_i = ((Δr_i + (Ad)_i) - rHat_i) + (AΔx)_i.
mathematical_definitions: For any length-n real vector v, (Av)_i := Σ_{j in Fin n} A(i,j)v_j.
All displayed operations are exact real-number operations, and all displayed equalities are exact.
The additions retain the Lean term's grouping: y_i = (x_i + d_i) + Δx_i and the conclusion's right side is ((Δr_i + (Ad)_i) - rHat_i) + (AΔx)_i.
translation.proposition_plain_english: For every natural dimension n, every real n-by-n matrix A, and all real vectors x, d, Δx, b, rHat, Δr, and y of length n, suppose pointwise that rHat equals the residual b - Ax plus Δr, and that y equals x + d plus Δx. Then, pointwise, the residual Ay - b equals Δr + Ad - rHat + AΔx, with the exact grouping ((Δr + Ad) - rHat) + AΔx.

restrictions_and_vacuity_risks: The matrix is restricted to be square, and all vectors have the same dimension n.
The dimension n is not required to be positive. When n = 0, Fin n is empty, so both pointwise hypotheses and the pointwise conclusion are vacuous.
For particular universally quantified choices of rHat or y that do not satisfy their respective hypotheses, the implication is true vacuously.
No invertibility, nonsingularity, rank, positivity, norm, magnitude, conditioning, or boundedness assumption is imposed on A or any vector.
No floating-point arithmetic, rounding model, error bound, norm estimate, tolerance, or computed-versus-exact distinction is encoded. The names rHat, Δr, and Δx carry no additional formal semantics.
The proposition contains no existential quantifiers, witness dependencies, constants beyond the implicit additive zero used by finite sums, or claims of existence or uniqueness.
